§6Solvent§f

§aCorrosive chemical feedstock for Mk.III upgrades, versatile circuits, and bedrock ore!§f

Solvent is a corrosive, flammable liquid produced by mixing §bAromatic Hydrocarbons§f and §bDesulfurized Naphtha§f in the §bIndustrial Mixer§f. It provides §e100 kTU§f per bucket, but its real value is in advanced crafting.

§6Production§f:
§b•§f §e500mB§f Aromatic Hydrocarbons + §e500mB§f Desulfurized Naphtha → §e1,000mB§f Solvent.

§6Uses§f:
§b•§f Effectiveness Upgrade Mk.III (Soldering Station): §e500mB§f Solvent + Capacitors + Microchips + Rubber.
§b•§f Versatile Circuit Board (Soldering Station): §e1,000mB§f Solvent + advanced components.
§b•§f Ore Acidizer: dissolves bedrock ore components.

§ePS:§f Solvent bridges the gap between basic petroleum processing and §bHPS§f. You need Desulfurized Naphtha from the Hydrotreater, so set up a dedicated Industrial Mixer feeding into your circuit production line!
